definitions.gloss: the next world, the afterlife, the other side
definitions.explanation: Refers to the world after death in Japanese spiritual and religious belief. Contrasted with この{世|よ} (this world).

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}はあの{世|よ}から{見守|みまも}っている。
examples.english: My grandmother is watching over us from the other side.

examples.japanese: あの{世|よ}に{行|い}ってもあなたを{忘|わす}れない。
examples.english: Even if I go to the afterlife, I won't forget you.

notes:
あの{世|よ} literally means "that world" and refers to the world after death. It is not tied to a specific religion — it reflects a general Japanese cultural concept of an afterlife.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- あの{世|よ}に{行|い}く: to pass away (euphemistic)
- あの{世|よ}で{会|あ}う: to meet in the afterlife
- あの{世|よ}から{見守|みまも}る: to watch over from the other side
- あの{世|よ}に{持|も}っていく: to take with one to the grave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- この{世|よ}: this world, the present life
- あの{世|よ}: the next world, the afterlife

USAGE:
Used in both solemn and casual contexts. Can appear in heartfelt expressions about deceased loved ones or in lighthearted exaggerations like あの{世|よ}に{行|い}っても{忘|わす}れない (I won't forget even in the afterlife).
